anchor.semantic_hook: Progression over time is staged literally as events traveling within a physical course through successive time markers.
anchor.setting: A broad indoor course curves through a civic hall, passing a sequence of hourglasses and blank calendar-shaped stone arches before reaching a low finish platform. A narrow stream forming the course flows uphill over every step without spilling, carrying small objects from one arch to the next.
anchor.absurd_element: an uphill-flowing stream that forms the course
